ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。

柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1.3Dモデリング

ゲーム内のキャラクター、環境、オブジェクトなどの3Dモデルを制作します。ゲームのテーマやストーリーに沿ったデザインを行います。

2.テクスチャリングとシェーディング

モデルにリアルな質感を与えるためのテクスチャリングとシェーディング作業を行います。

3.リギングとアニメーションの準備

キャラクターやオブジェクトが自然に動くためのリギングを行い、アニメーターが使用するための準備をします。

4.アートスタイルの維持

ゲーム全体のアートスタイルに一貫性を持たせるため、他のアーティストと連携しながら作業を進めます。

5.ビジュアルコンセプトの実現

ゲームのビジュアルコンセプトに基づいて、アイデアを具体化し、魅力的なビジュアルを創り出します。

6.ドキュメント作成

作業手順や技術的なドキュメントを整備し、チーム内での情報共有を促進します。

Job Description

1. 3D Modeling

- Create 3D models of characters, environments, and objects for in-game use, ensuring designs align with the game's theme and story.

2. Texturing and Shading

- Perform texturing and shading tasks to give models realistic surface qualities.

3. Rigging and Animation Preparation

- Set up rigging for characters and objects to ensure natural movement and prepare them for use by animators.

4. Maintaining Art Style

- Work collaboratively with other artists to maintain consistency in the overall art style of the game.

5. Visual Concept Realization

- Bring ideas to life based on the game’s visual concept, creating appealing visuals.

6. Documentation

- Prepare work procedures and technical documents to facilitate information sharing within the team.

応募資格/Who We Look For

応募資格

1.3Dアート制作の経験（AAAまたはAAプロジェクトが望ましい）

2.3Dモデリングツールの使用スキル（Maya、3ds Max、Blenderなど）

3.テクスチャリングおよびシェーディングに関する知識

4.3Aアクションゲームの開発経験（優遇）

5.優れた描写能力と創造力

6.チームでの協力とコミュニケーション能力

7.フォトリアルでの3Dモデル製作の経験(優遇)

Qualifications

- Experience in 3D art production (preferably in AAA or AA projects)

- Proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (such as Maya, 3ds Max, Blender)

- Knowledge of texturing and shading

- Experience in developing AAA action games(preferred)

- Strong drawing skills and creativity

- Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team

- Experience in creating photorealistic 3D models (preferred)

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?
勤務地
大阪（JR大阪駅JP TOWER OSAKA）、東京（虎ノ門ヒルズビジネスタワー）※希望に添います

賃金
年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）
※経験・スキル等を考慮し、当社規定により優遇します。
※一般社員の場合、固定残業代月35時間分が含まれます。
管理職の場合、固定残業代10時間分が含まれます。

労働時間・休日
就業時間 09:30 ~ 18:30　 休憩時間 60分
フレックスタイムあり
完全週休２日制（土日・祝日）
有給休暇：入社初年度は、入社月により期間按分付与。在籍年数踏まえて最大22日
年末年始休暇（12/30～1/3）
病気休暇（有給）：12日/年（有給休暇とは別途付与）

福利厚生
＜各種保険＞
健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）
海外旅行保険

＜各種手当＞
通勤手当(上限5万円/月) 、通信手当（上限1万円/月）、 自己啓発手当（上限2万円/月）、 平日に出社した場合食事補助1800円/日、定期健診手当（上限7万5千円/年1回）

＜支援制度・その他待遇＞
フリードリンクコーナー 、ギフトカード（お盆、正月の2回支給、2万円/1回）
従業員支援プログラム(EAP) 、慶弔見舞金 、永年勤続賞/休暇

title: Project Management Intern
description:
Business Unit
LIGHTSPEED STUDIOS is made up of passionate players who advance the art & science of game development through great stories, great gameplay, and advanced technology. We are focused on bringing next generation experiences to gamers who want to enjoy them anywhere, anytime, across multiple genres and devices.

About the Hiring Team
Lightspeed Tech Center is a R&D department under Lightspeed Studios which develop PUBG Mobile and other high-quality games. Our Tech Center leads the research, exploration, and discovery of innovative technologies and provides technical services for all games during all phases of life cycle, including engine, audio, QA, AI, next generation game, technical cooperation, etc.

What the Role Entails

1. Game Co-dev Coordination & Resource Alignment: Align, identify, and sort out game product and technical requirements across diverse co-development partners, external game studios, and internal development teams; coordinate global resources to ensure clear scope boundaries and shared ownership.

2. Cross-region Game Milestone & Delivery Management: Formulate, track, and synchronize master project plans across different time zones and regions; manage the delivery pipeline of game assets (Art, Animation, Audio) and code integration to ensure multi-site milestones are met on time.

3. Cross-cultural Game Workflow & Standardization: Establish, optimize, and promote standard remote-collaboration workflows and communication protocols to bridge cultural gaps and language barriers, ensuring efficient game asset handovers and review processes.

4.Distributed Team Risk & Conflict Management: Proactively identify and solve project bottlenecks unique to distributed game development (e.g., communication lag, build integration friction, cultural mismatches) to minimize project risks and maintain alignment.

5. Game Industry & Tech Trend Research: Conduct deep-dive market and desk research on global gaming industries and emerging technology trends (including but not limited to Generative AI, AI-driven game development tools, and innovative gameplay metrics), delivering actionable insight reports.

Who We Look For

1. Global Mindset & Cross-cultural Communication: Exceptional cross-cultural communication, interpersonal, and translation/documentation skills; ability to comfortably collaborate with diverse stakeholders from different cultural and game development backgrounds.

2. Distributed Game Project Management: Solid understanding of the game development lifecycle (GDLC), with practical experience or strong knowledge in distributed/remote team management, art outsourcing coordination, or multi-site agile frameworks.

3. Game Research & Analytical Skills: Strong desk research capabilities with a high sensitivity to game market trends; familiar with AI toolsets (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Copilot) and how they apply to gaming tech or productivity improvement.

4. Language & Time-zone Adaptability: Proficient in English (and other languages depending on region) as a working language; high flexibility to work across different time zones to align with global game studios.

5. Preferred Qualifications: Experience living/studying abroad, prior internship in an international game studio (PMO/Outsourcing/Localization), or a deep gamer with insights into various genres is highly preferred.

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

title: Cyber Security Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team
Tencent Overseas IT has the mission to empower Tencent’s rapid global growth with future ready, global IT platforms, applications and services. We are chartered to lead the Overseas IT strategy, architecture, roadmap and execution. Satisfying our internal/external customers and becoming a world class global IT team are our top aspirations.

What the Role Entails

About the Role

We are seeking an enthusiastic Cyber Security Intern to join our Security Engineering team in London. This is a hands-on placement providing practical experience across Security Operations (SOC), cloud security, vulnerability management, incident response and security engineering.

Working alongside experienced Senior Security Engineers, you will gain exposure to enterprise security technologies including Microsoft 365, firewalls, Slack, cloud services and endpoint security while supporting the protection of our business systems and data.

Key Responsibilities

•
Assist with Tier 1 Security Operations Centre (SOC) alert triage, investigation and escalation using Microsoft Sentinel and other security monitoring platforms.

•
Investigate potential security incidents by analysing alerts generated from firewalls, Microsoft 365, Slack and other cloud services.

•
Perform log analysis across SIEM and cloud platforms to identify suspicious activity and support incident investigations.

•
Assist in vulnerability management by validating findings, supporting remediation activities and coordinating with internal IT teams.

•
Support security reviews and risk assessments for new business initiatives, including AI tools, AI agents and third-party SaaS integrations such as Outlook, Slack, Miro and other collaboration platforms.

•
Support the implementation, testing and validation of security controls including firewalls controls, email security and endpoint protection, cloud security posture management

•
Participate in simulated cyber security exercises, phishing simulations and purple team activities to validate security controls and SOC detection capabilities.

•
Research emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities and attack techniques to improve organisational security awareness.

•
Document security incidents, investigations and recommendations for review by Senior Security Engineers.

•
Support and work with compliance team initiatives aligned with different standard such as ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR and internal security policies.

•
Contribute to continuous improvements in SOC processes, documentation, automation and security monitoring capabilities.

Who We Look For

Essential Skills and Experience

•
Currently studying Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Security or a related degree.

•
Strong interest in cyber security, cloud technologies and enterprise IT.

•
Basic understanding of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP and VPN technologies.

•
Familiarity with Windows, Microsoft 365 and cloud-based collaboration platforms.

•
Strong analytical thinking with excellent attention to detail.

•
Effective written and verbal communication skills.

•
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work collaboratively within a technical team.

•
Eagerness to learn and develop professional cyber security skills.

Desirable Skills

•
Knowledge of SIEM platforms such as ElasticSearch

•
Basic scripting experience using PowerShell or Python.

•
Understanding of vulnerability management and remediation processes.

•
Awareness of the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

•
Knowledge of Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

•
Experience with security automation or scripting is advantageous.

Learning Opportunities

Throughout the placement, you will receive mentoring from Senior Security Engineers and gain practical experience in:

•
Security Operations Centre (SOC) processes

•
Incident response

•
Cloud security

•
Security engineering

•
Vulnerability management

•
AI security governance

•
Enterprise security architecture

•
Security automation

•
Compliance and governance

title: Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern
description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails

Join our dynamic Tencent Finance team as Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern where you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in real-world accounting and financial practices. You will be having the exposure to the end-to-end accounting and finance processes, focusing either on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Finance Operations, offering you tailored hands-on experience in the complex commercial and business environment. This role is designed to provide you with a deep understanding of financial processes, contributing directly to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial reporting and operations.

Responsibilities

• Maintain and reconcile the General Ledger (GL), ensuring accurate and timely financial entries.

• Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities, including account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, and variance analysis.

• Verify, process, and manage Accounts Payable (AP) transactions, ensuring timely vendor payments and handling any discrepancies.

• Support Accounts Receivable (AR) activities by assisting in customer invoicing, tracking payments, and managing overdue receivables.

• Collaborate with teams to streamline Finance Operations, helping to enhance process efficiency and support financial audits by preparing relevant documentation.

• Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.

•
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months from November 2026/January 2027 onwards.

•
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.

•
Strong analytical and presentation skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.

#LI-HC1

title: Senior Marketing Manager JD (AAA Racing Game Title)
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.
5. Collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams, including operations, UA, regional marketing teams, and platform partnership teams, integrate in-game resources with global and regional resources, and drive the quality execution of final solutions.
6. Deeply participate in the development and execution coordination of market strategies in key regions, ensuring localized messaging and precise localization are implemented within a globally consistent brand framework.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

The Senior UX Researcher (Astra) will lead user experience research initiatives to support the growth and success of Interactive Entertainment Group Global (IEEG) invested game studios in North America and Europe, and possibly in other regions. This role will ensure that player insights are integrated into game design and development processes, driving player satisfaction and business growth. The Senior UX Researcher will collaborate closely with partnered studios, Shenzhen-based partner teams, and IEG and IEGG support functions, such as iMur, Checkpoint and other support departments and vendors.

Core Responsibilities

UX Research Leadership:

• Design and execute comprehensive UX research studies to evaluate player behavior, preferences, and pain points across multiple game titles.

• Collaborate with invested studios to identify research needs and provide strategic guidance on UX improvements.

• Work closely with iMur, Checkpoint and external UX lab vendors, to leverage their resources and expertise in conducting lab-based and remote user testing.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。

description:

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

岗位职责：

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

2.具备数据建模、机器学习或AI算法应用的实际经验；

3.有自主搭建数据看板、BI系统或数据可视化平台经验；

4.熟悉游戏运营流程，能够快速理解游戏玩法与用户行为模式；

5.有数据驱动决策的成功案例，能清晰展示数据分析对业务带来的实际影响。

title: Marketing Manager
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. IP品牌策略与传播 —— 负责成熟游戏产品的IP品牌建设与用户口碑营销，基于产品核心卖点与用户画像，制定市场发行策略，主导创意构思并推动高质量落地执行；

2. 内容生态与流量增长 —— 深刻理解主流内容平台的流量分发逻辑，保持敏锐的热点感知与内容创新能力，策划并产出具备自传播力的PGC及UGC内容，持续扩大IP传播声量与用户影响力；

3. 跨界联动与资源整合 —— 策划并引入泛娱乐、异业合作、文旅联动等外部资源，主导跨界传播内容及话题事件的全流程落地，拓展IP破圈能力；

4. 用户洞察与策略迭代 —— 统筹用户沟通与调研体系，协同用研团队持续深化用户画像，以洞察反哺市场策略，驱动发行打法与用户沟通策略的动态优化；

5. 整合营销与效果度量 —— 拆解整合营销全链路，搭建可量化的效果追踪体系与评估标准，结合内容数据复盘与分析，持续迭代发行策略与执行手段。

岗位要求

1. 本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告传播、心理学或游戏相关专业优先；
2. 5年以上游戏行业市场营销经验，至少主导过1款产品的全案传播及IP联动项目，有成熟案例可展示；
3. 市场嗅觉敏锐，深谙抖音、B站、小红书等平台的内容生态与流量机制，有爆款创意内容或事件营销的成功操盘经验者优先；
4. 熟悉主流AI大模型及效率工具，能将其有效嵌入发行工作流并持续优化提效，对AI赋能营销有实际应用经验；
5. 数据驱动、结果导向，具备复杂问题的拆解、定位与解决能力，善于从执行数据中发现趋势或风险，推动策略调整与落地；
6. 出色的跨部门沟通与项目管理能力，既能深入理解用户视角与诉求，也能高效推进组织内外多方协作，确保项目闭环。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

description:

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1.3Dモデリング

ゲーム内のキャラクター、環境、オブジェクトなどの3Dモデルを制作します。ゲームのテーマやストーリーに沿ったデザインを行います。

2.テクスチャリングとシェーディング

モデルにリアルな質感を与えるためのテクスチャリングとシェーディング作業を行います。

3.リギングとアニメーションの準備

キャラクターやオブジェクトが自然に動くためのリギングを行い、アニメーターが使用するための準備をします。

4.アートスタイルの維持

ゲーム全体のアートスタイルに一貫性を持たせるため、他のアーティストと連携しながら作業を進めます。

5.ビジュアルコンセプトの実現

ゲームのビジュアルコンセプトに基づいて、アイデアを具体化し、魅力的なビジュアルを創り出します。

6.ドキュメント作成

作業手順や技術的なドキュメントを整備し、チーム内での情報共有を促進します。

Job Description

1. 3D Modeling

- Create 3D models of characters, environments, and objects for in-game use, ensuring designs align with the game's theme and story.

2. Texturing and Shading

- Perform texturing and shading tasks to give models realistic surface qualities.

3. Rigging and Animation Preparation

- Set up rigging for characters and objects to ensure natural movement and prepare them for use by animators.

4. Maintaining Art Style

- Work collaboratively with other artists to maintain consistency in the overall art style of the game.

5. Visual Concept Realization

- Bring ideas to life based on the game’s visual concept, creating appealing visuals.

6. Documentation

- Prepare work procedures and technical documents to facilitate information sharing within the team.

1.3Dアート制作の経験（AAAまたはAAプロジェクトが望ましい）

2.3Dモデリングツールの使用スキル（Maya、3ds Max、Blenderなど）

3.テクスチャリングおよびシェーディングに関する知識

4.3Aアクションゲームの開発経験（優遇）

5.優れた描写能力と創造力

6.チームでの協力とコミュニケーション能力

7.フォトリアルでの3Dモデル製作の経験(優遇)

Qualifications

- Experience in 3D art production (preferably in AAA or AA projects)

- Proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (such as Maya, 3ds Max, Blender)

- Knowledge of texturing and shading

- Experience in developing AAA action games(preferred)

- Strong drawing skills and creativity

- Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team

2. Distributed Game Project Management: Solid understanding of the game development lifecycle (GDLC), with practical experience or strong knowledge in distributed/remote team management, art outsourcing coordination, or multi-site agile frameworks.

3. Game Research & Analytical Skills: Strong desk research capabilities with a high sensitivity to game market trends; familiar with AI toolsets (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Copilot) and how they apply to gaming tech or productivity improvement.

Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

• Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.

• Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.

Job Requirements

• Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

• Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

• Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.

• Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

title: Senior Marketing Manager JD (AAA Racing Game Title)
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

title: Data Science Intern (Analytics), 6-month internship
description:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

What the Role Entails

• Analyze large-scale datasets to solve complex business and technical challenges in gaming through analytics, forecasting, machine learning, recommender systems, generative AI, experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to develop data-driven strategies and implement solutions that enhance business value.

• Deliver actionable business insights to internal and external stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain robust data scraping and collection pipelines (web crawling, API ingestion, data wrangling) to gather competitive intelligence, market signals, and player/community data at scale.

description:
团队介绍
腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。

商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责

1.负责部门 Agent 产品研发，与业务、Agent 产品及运营团队紧密合作，将业务需求转化为可实现、可验证、可量化的技术方案，承担架构设计、前后端开发、测试、部署及持续迭代的完整闭环。

2.负责 Agent 核心能力建设，包括企业知识库、RAG、记忆系统、工具调用、业务 Agent、MCP，以及 Multi-Agent 与人机协作流程的设计和实施。

3.负责 Agent 与腾讯内部基础设施及产品的集成，包括模型与 Agent 平台、权限身份体系、知识库及数据平台，并通过 API、SDK、MCP等方式建设稳定、可复用的连接能力。

4.建设部门 Agent Benchmark、评测与可观测体系，通过自动化评测、回归测试、Tracing、日志监控和反馈闭环，持续优化任务成功率、生成质量、稳定性、响应速度及成本。

5.建设生产级工程与安全保障体系，包括 CI/CD、自动化测试、灰度发布、故障恢复、权限控制、操作审计和数据隔离，保障 Agent 产品安全稳定运行。

岗位要求

1.本科及以上学历，5 年以上软件研发经验，具备复杂系统或产品从0到1交付经验；能力和作品突出者可适当放宽。

2.熟练掌握 JavaScript/TypeScript，熟悉 React 或 Vue 中至少一种主流前端框架。熟练使用 Python、Go、Java或基于 Node.js 的服务端开发技术，熟悉 API、数据库、缓存及异步任务，具备独立全栈交付能力。

3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。

4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。

生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。

企业知识图谱、agent/LLM评测或反馈数据闭环经验。

企业数据库系统建设，多来源数据库治理经验。

岗位职责

岗位职责：

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

Who We Look For

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Currently studying Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Security or a related degree.

Eagerness to learn and develop professional cyber security skills.

Knowledge of Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

•
Security Operations Centre (SOC) processes

•
Incident response

•
Cloud security

Security engineering

description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. • Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.

•
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months from November 2026/January 2027 onwards.

•
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.

•
Strong analytical and presentation skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.

- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

2.具备数据建模、机器学习或AI算法应用的实际经验；

3.有自主搭建数据看板、BI系统或数据可视化平台经验；

4.熟悉游戏运营流程，能够快速理解游戏玩法与用户行为模式；

5.有数据驱动决策的成功案例，能清晰展示数据分析对业务带来的实际影响。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Marketing Manager
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. IP品牌策略与传播 —— 负责成熟游戏产品的IP品牌建设与用户口碑营销，基于产品核心卖点与用户画像，制定市场发行策略，主导创意构思并推动高质量落地执行；

2. 内容生态与流量增长 —— 深刻理解主流内容平台的流量分发逻辑，保持敏锐的热点感知与内容创新能力，策划并产出具备自传播力的PGC及UGC内容，持续扩大IP传播声量与用户影响力；

5. 整合营销与效果度量 —— 拆解整合营销全链路，搭建可量化的效果追踪体系与评估标准，结合内容数据复盘与分析，持续迭代发行策略与执行手段。

岗位要求

1. 本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告传播、心理学或游戏相关专业优先；
2. 5年以上游戏行业市场营销经验，至少主导过1款产品的全案传播及IP联动项目，有成熟案例可展示；
3. 市场嗅觉敏锐，深谙抖音、B站、小红书等平台的内容生态与流量机制，有爆款创意内容或事件营销的成功操盘经验者优先；
4. 熟悉主流AI大模型及效率工具，能将其有效嵌入发行工作流并持续优化提效，对AI赋能营销有实际应用经验；
5. 数据驱动、结果导向，具备复杂问题的拆解、定位与解决能力，善于从执行数据中发现趋势或风险，推动策略调整与落地；
6. 出色的跨部门沟通与项目管理能力，既能深入理解用户视角与诉求，也能高效推进组织内外多方协作，确保项目闭环。

title: Senior Marketing Manager JD (AAA Racing Game Title)
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.
5. Collaborate with multiple cross-functional teams, including operations, UA, regional marketing teams, and platform partnership teams, integrate in-game resources with global and regional resources, and drive the quality execution of final solutions.
6. Deeply participate in the development and execution coordination of market strategies in key regions, ensuring localized messaging and precise localization are implemented within a globally consistent brand framework.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。

4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。

生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。

description:

岗位职责

岗位职责：

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

2.具备数据建模、机器学习或AI算法应用的实际经验；

3.有自主搭建数据看板、BI系统或数据可视化平台经验；

4.熟悉游戏运营流程，能够快速理解游戏玩法与用户行为模式；

5.有数据驱动决策的成功案例，能清晰展示数据分析对业务带来的实际影响。

title: Marketing Manager
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. IP品牌策略与传播 —— 负责成熟游戏产品的IP品牌建设与用户口碑营销，基于产品核心卖点与用户画像，制定市场发行策略，主导创意构思并推动高质量落地执行；

2. 内容生态与流量增长 —— 深刻理解主流内容平台的流量分发逻辑，保持敏锐的热点感知与内容创新能力，策划并产出具备自传播力的PGC及UGC内容，持续扩大IP传播声量与用户影响力；

3. 跨界联动与资源整合 —— 策划并引入泛娱乐、异业合作、文旅联动等外部资源，主导跨界传播内容及话题事件的全流程落地，拓展IP破圈能力；

4. 用户洞察与策略迭代 —— 统筹用户沟通与调研体系，协同用研团队持续深化用户画像，以洞察反哺市场策略，驱动发行打法与用户沟通策略的动态优化；

5. 整合营销与效果度量 —— 拆解整合营销全链路，搭建可量化的效果追踪体系与评估标准，结合内容数据复盘与分析，持续迭代发行策略与执行手段。

岗位要求

1. 本科及以上学历，市场营销、广告传播、心理学或游戏相关专业优先；
2. 5年以上游戏行业市场营销经验，至少主导过1款产品的全案传播及IP联动项目，有成熟案例可展示；
3. 市场嗅觉敏锐，深谙抖音、B站、小红书等平台的内容生态与流量机制，有爆款创意内容或事件营销的成功操盘经验者优先；
4. 熟悉主流AI大模型及效率工具，能将其有效嵌入发行工作流并持续优化提效，对AI赋能营销有实际应用经验；
5. 数据驱动、结果导向，具备复杂问题的拆解、定位与解决能力，善于从执行数据中发现趋势或风险，推动策略调整与落地；
6. 出色的跨部门沟通与项目管理能力，既能深入理解用户视角与诉求，也能高效推进组织内外多方协作，确保项目闭环。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

description:

仕事内容

ゲーム内のキャラクター、環境、オブジェクトなどの3Dモデルを制作します。ゲームのテーマやストーリーに沿ったデザインを行います。

2.テクスチャリングとシェーディング

モデルにリアルな質感を与えるためのテクスチャリングとシェーディング作業を行います。

3.リギングとアニメーションの準備

キャラクターやオブジェクトが自然に動くためのリギングを行い、アニメーターが使用するための準備をします。

ゲーム全体のアートスタイルに一貫性を持たせるため、他のアーティストと連携しながら作業を進めます。

5.ビジュアルコンセプトの実現

ゲームのビジュアルコンセプトに基づいて、アイデアを具体化し、魅力的なビジュアルを創り出します。

6.ドキュメント作成

作業手順や技術的なドキュメントを整備し、チーム内での情報共有を促進します。

Job Description

1. 3D Modeling

- Create 3D models of characters, environments, and objects for in-game use, ensuring designs align with the game's theme and story.

2. Texturing and Shading

- Perform texturing and shading tasks to give models realistic surface qualities.

3. Rigging and Animation Preparation

- Set up rigging for characters and objects to ensure natural movement and prepare them for use by animators.

4. Maintaining Art Style

- Work collaboratively with other artists to maintain consistency in the overall art style of the game.

5. Visual Concept Realization

- Bring ideas to life based on the game’s visual concept, creating appealing visuals.

6. Documentation

- Prepare work procedures and technical documents to facilitate information sharing within the team.

1.3Dアート制作の経験（AAAまたはAAプロジェクトが望ましい）

2.3Dモデリングツールの使用スキル（Maya、3ds Max、Blenderなど）

3.テクスチャリングおよびシェーディングに関する知識

4.3Aアクションゲームの開発経験（優遇）

5.優れた描写能力と創造力

6.チームでの協力とコミュニケーション能力

Qualifications

- Experience in 3D art production (preferably in AAA or AA projects)

- Proficiency in using 3D modeling tools (such as Maya, 3ds Max, Blender)

- Knowledge of texturing and shading

- Experience in developing AAA action games(preferred)

- Strong drawing skills and creativity

Beyond solution delivery, you will act as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, bringing customer feedback into product evolution while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. • Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

• Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing solution performance in production environments.

• Design scalable AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, and cloud-native AI services.

Job Requirements

• Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

• Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

• Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of AI model deployment, inference services, and production operations.

• Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

• Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

title: Senior Marketing Manager JD (AAA Racing Game Title)
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

1. Develop the overall brand marketing strategy, positioning, and core messaging framework for the AAA driving game product before and after its global launch, ensuring consistent communication of the brand concept across regions worldwide.
2. Lead brand creative work throughout the product's full lifecycle from testing through post-launch, including creative planning and execution for key marketing milestones such as the global first reveal, test-phase promotions, integrated online and offline marketing campaigns, and launch events.
3. Develop a deep understanding of the core console/PC player ecosystem and global driving culture communities, formulate community growth and engagement strategies, maintain relationships with core players, and stimulate the content ecosystem.
4. Continuously track market trends in the driving and open-world racing categories, competitor developments, and player feedback, providing data-driven insights for marketing decisions and product optimization.

Who We Look For

1. Required Experience:
- 5+ years of experience in game industry marketing or brand roles.
- Proven experience successfully leading AAA console/PC game brand projects; candidates with experience in open-world, driving/racing, or RPG projects are preferred.
- Global market GTM marketing experience, with familiarity with player ecosystems in at least 2 regional markets (North America/Europe/Asia).
2. Core Competencies
- Deep understanding of driving culture and player psychology: Understands the appeal of automotive culture and the driving experience, and can accurately grasp the community language, emotional needs, and behavioral patterns of driving game players.
- Fluent English: Near-native written and spoken English proficiency, with the ability to independently write English brand copy and creative briefs, understand the vision of overseas studios, and communicate seamlessly with international teams and overseas partners.
- Passion for games: Hardcore gamer with a deep understanding of the console/PC gaming ecosystem and familiarity with the full lifecycle of AAA game launch marketing. Hands-on experience with driving/racing games is preferred.
- Strategy and creativity: Possesses both systematic brand strategy thinking and sharp creative judgment, with the ability to lead end-to-end marketing output.
3. Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

title: Tencent Cloud – AI & LLM Solution Architect
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails

Position Overview

Tencent Cloud is seeking an AI & LLM Solution Architect to accelerate the adoption of Tencent Cloud's enterprise AI platform across Europe. This customer-facing technical role combines solution architecture, customer engineering, and hands-on AI implementation to help enterprises design, build, deploy, and scale production-ready AI applications. Leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub—a unified AI platform providing access to leading Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem—you will work closely with enterprise customers, Product, Engineering, Research, and Commercial teams to bridge business challenges with innovative AI solutions. Beyond solution delivery, you will serve as the technical bridge between customers and Tencent Cloud's AI product organization, translating real-world customer requirements into product enhancements while accelerating enterprise AI adoption. TokenHub provides enterprises and developers with a unified gateway to leading foundation models through a single API, together with enterprise-grade model management, inference, deployment, monitoring, and AI application capabilities. Product Link: https://www.tencentcloud.com/products/tokenhub?from_qcintl=topnav

Responsibilities

•
Partner with enterprise customers to understand business challenges, identify AI transformation opportunities, and design end-to-end AI and LLM solutions leveraging Tencent Cloud TokenHub, leading foundation models, AI Agents, MCP ecosystem, and enterprise AI capabilities.

•
Lead technical discovery workshops, architecture design sessions, Proof-of-Concepts (POCs), technical validation, and production deployment planning to accelerate enterprise AI adoption.

•
Work directly with customer engineering teams throughout implementation and production rollout, troubleshooting complex technical issues and optimizing AI application performance within enterprise production environments.

•
Design scalable enterprise AI architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, API integration, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI services.

•
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to translate customer requirements into platform enhancements, improve developer experience, and continuously evolve Tencent Cloud's AI platform through customer-driven feedback.

•
Develop reusable reference architectures, implementation frameworks, sample applications, technical playbooks, and best practices that accelerate enterprise AI adoption across European customers and partners.

•
Support strategic enterprise opportunities by leading technical proposals, architecture reviews, executive presentations, tender responses, and technical due diligence throughout the customer lifecycle.

Who We Look For

•
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

•
Minimum 2 years of experience in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning, AI platforms, cloud computing, software engineering, MLOps, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical consulting.

•
Hands-on experience with modern AI technologies including LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Agents, MCP, model fine-tuning, inference optimization, vector databases, AI orchestration frameworks, API integration, and cloud-native AI architectures.

•
Experience developing or deploying enterprise AI applications on public cloud platforms, with practical knowledge of multi-model AI orchestration, model deployment, inference services, observability, and production operations.

•
Strong customer-facing communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable AI solutions.

•
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese Mandarin is required to collaborate with China headquarters on product discussions, technical design, and cross-functional initiatives.

•
Self-driven with strong learning agility, curiosity for emerging AI technologies, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced customer-facing environment.

title: Data Science Intern (Analytics), 6-month internship
description:
Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

What the Role Entails

• Analyze large-scale datasets to solve complex business and technical challenges in gaming through analytics, forecasting, machine learning, recommender systems, generative AI, experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to develop data-driven strategies and implement solutions that enhance business value.

• Deliver actionable business insights to internal and external stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain robust data scraping and collection pipelines (web crawling, API ingestion, data wrangling) to gather competitive intelligence, market signals, and player/community data at scale.

description:
团队介绍
腾讯游戏商务部的主旨是建立腾讯与全球优质厂商的桥梁，服务与全球100+投资伙伴和重要厂商。持续扩大腾讯在全球互联网生态和游戏行业的影响力，利用敏锐的嗅觉捕捉高潜力商业合作机会，并帮助投资伙伴持续的成长。深耕亚太、欧美和新兴市场，与日本、韩国、美国、英国、法国、芬兰、德国等成熟市场和东南亚、中东、土耳其等新区域的伙伴建立了深度的战略合作关系，实现商业上的共赢。

商务部期待全球的优秀人才一同加入，通过全球的优质人才网络巩固和扩大腾讯与全球合作伙伴的合作关系，并为市场孵化更多优质的游戏产品。

岗位职责

1.负责部门 Agent 产品研发，与业务、Agent 产品及运营团队紧密合作，将业务需求转化为可实现、可验证、可量化的技术方案，承担架构设计、前后端开发、测试、部署及持续迭代的完整闭环。

2.负责 Agent 核心能力建设，包括企业知识库、RAG、记忆系统、工具调用、业务 Agent、MCP，以及 Multi-Agent 与人机协作流程的设计和实施。

3.负责 Agent 与腾讯内部基础设施及产品的集成，包括模型与 Agent 平台、权限身份体系、知识库及数据平台，并通过 API、SDK、MCP等方式建设稳定、可复用的连接能力。

4.建设部门 Agent Benchmark、评测与可观测体系，通过自动化评测、回归测试、Tracing、日志监控和反馈闭环，持续优化任务成功率、生成质量、稳定性、响应速度及成本。

5.建设生产级工程与安全保障体系，包括 CI/CD、自动化测试、灰度发布、故障恢复、权限控制、操作审计和数据隔离，保障 Agent 产品安全稳定运行。

岗位要求

1.本科及以上学历，5 年以上软件研发经验，具备复杂系统或产品从0到1交付经验；能力和作品突出者可适当放宽。

2.熟练掌握 JavaScript/TypeScript，熟悉 React 或 Vue 中至少一种主流前端框架。熟练使用 Python、Go、Java或基于 Node.js 的服务端开发技术，熟悉 API、数据库、缓存及异步任务，具备独立全栈交付能力。

3.理解 Agent Loop、Memory、Tool Calling、RAG、MCP、Planning及 Multi-Agent 等技术，并具备实际 Agent 项目开发或生产落地经验。

4.具备良好的工程、产品和跨团队协作能力，重视代码质量、测试、可观测性、安全性及上线结果，能够熟练使用 AI Coding 工具提升研发效率。

生产级 Agent、开发者工具或企业知识助手的落地经验。

企业知识图谱、agent/LLM评测或反馈数据闭环经验。

企业数据库系统建设，多来源数据库治理经验。

岗位职责

岗位职责：

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

Who We Look For

• Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Currently studying Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Security or a related degree.

Eagerness to learn and develop professional cyber security skills.

Knowledge of Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

•
Security Operations Centre (SOC) processes

•
Incident response

•
Cloud security

Security engineering

description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. • Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.

•
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months from November 2026/January 2027 onwards.

•
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.

•
Strong analytical and presentation skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.

- Experience in co-marketing with console platform partners is preferred.
- Ability to collaborate with regional marketing teams and support coordination with overseas regional markets.
- Automotive brand cross-over partnership experience or automotive media/KOL resources are preferred; experience in creator community operations or UGC content ecosystems is also preferred.
4. Personal Attributes
- Strong execution and drive: Self-motivated, skilled at cross-department coordination, and capable of driving complex projects to completion across multicultural, multi-time-zone teams.
- Strategic thinker: Able to establish clear frameworks in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.
- Passion for automotive culture: Genuinely cares about cars, driving, and the relationship between people and cars.

description:

Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

岗位职责：

1.负责构建和完善游戏项目运营数据分析体系，系统性整理、统计和分析日常游戏业务数据，撰写高质量的分析报告；

2.针对游戏项目开展专项数据分析，涵盖用户价值、流失分析、游戏生态、版本活动效果评估、用户画像分析等，为运营决策和产品优化提供数据支撑；

3.深入研究用户精细化运营策略，包括但不限于用户分层、精准营销和用户生命周期管理，推动用户价值提升；

4.主导游戏业务数据能力建设，包括底层日志结构设计、数据清洗流程优化、可视化报表平台搭建与维护；

5.沉淀数据分析方法论与框架，协同数据技术及开发团队进行数据建模，持续优化和迭代精细化运营分析体系。

6.开展用户研究工作，通过问卷、访谈、玩家反馈及行为数据等方式，理解不同用户群体的需求、体验和流失原因，并将研究结论转化为可执行建议；

岗位要求

能力特质：

1.计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业本科及以上学历，具备3年以上游戏行业数据分析或相关岗位工作经验，具备海外成熟发行业务数据分析经验者优先；

2.对数据敏感，具备较强的逻辑思维、问题拆解和分析能力，能够从数据与用户反馈中发现问题、形成判断并提出建议；

3.熟悉大数据相关知识体系，包括数据仓库建设、数据可视化、用户画像构建等，有实际项目经验者优先；

4.熟练使用Excel和SQL，能够独立完成数据提取、清洗和基础分析；熟练使用AI工具者和数据挖掘技能者优先；

5.具备良好的沟通协作、自我驱动和跨团队推动能力，对游戏行业保持持续兴趣和敏感度；

加分项：

1.有开放世界类、射击类、竞技类游戏的数据分析项目经验；

2.具备数据建模、机器学习或AI算法应用的实际经验；

3.有自主搭建数据看板、BI系统或数据可视化平台经验；

4.熟悉游戏运营流程，能够快速理解游戏玩法与用户行为模式；

5.有数据驱动决策的成功案例，能清晰展示数据分析对业务带来的实际影响。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。
