Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1、AI Copilot 系统研发：负责本地化 AI Copilot 系统的架构设计与核心代码编写，实现 AI 辅助翻译、术语推荐、译后编辑（PE）等功能。

2、向量检索与 RAG 落地：负责向量数据库（Vector DB）的选型、搭建与优化；利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将现有的翻译记忆库（TM）和术语库（TB）转化为向量，实现高召回、高精准的上下文检索。

3、主流大模型（LLM）接入与性能优化：负责将 Google Cloud（Vertex AI / Gemini）、OpenAI、Claude 等海外主流 AI 模型，通过 API 高效、稳定地接入公司现有的本地化作业平台与 CAT 自动化流水线；并解决大模型调用中的高并发、高延迟、API 限流等问题，优化 Token 消耗成本。

4、Prompt 工程与调优：主导面向多语种（特别是复杂语种，如韩语、泰语、缅甸语、西语等）的 Prompt 设计、微调与评估；通过 Few-shot、COT、Structured Output 等技术，确保 AI 翻译在字数限制、标签（Tag）保留、语气风格上达到工业级游戏本地化标准。

5、本地化 TMS 系统开发与运维：负责本地化 TMS 系统的新特性开发与已有功能的维护、性能优化，实现本地化流程自动化和全球应用。

6、本地化业务支持：理解游戏本地化流程与实践，利用 AI 与工具能力持续优化本地化效率与质量；后续可负责一到多款游戏的多语言本地化，与上游研发团队和发行团队沟通、制定整体本地化计划与预算、交付符合质量要求的本地化多语言版本。

岗位要求

1、本科及以上学历，计算机、语言类、本地化或相关专业，有3年以上实际开发经验。扎实的编程能力，熟练掌握 Python / Go / Node.js 中的至少一种开发语言，具备良好的编码规范。

2、大模型开发经验：熟悉 LangChain、LlamaIndex 等主流 LLM 开发框架，有实际的大模型 API（如 Google Vertex AI, OpenAI）对接与工程化落地经验。

3、向量数据库经验：熟悉至少一种向量数据库（如 Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, Chroma），理解向量嵌入（Embedding）原理，有 RAG 系统调优经验者优先；同事具备优秀的Prompt 能力，对 Prompt Engineering 有深入理解，能够熟练编写结构化 Prompt，并能通过自动评估或评测集不断迭代 Prompt 效果。

4、游戏本地化认知：了解游戏端内外内容的本地化流程和实践，有游戏本地化版本成功交付经验者优先；熟悉翻译、审校、 配音或LQA流程，对游戏本地化有独到的见解，善于利用工具和 AI 能力持续优化本地化效率和质量。

5、熟悉本地化业务：熟悉翻译记忆库（TMX）、术语表（TBX）、CAT 工具；具备MS office等本地化行业常见文档格式处理能力和经验者优先。

6、英语能力：书面或口头交流顺畅，能快速阅读英文技术文档，并与海外团队、供应商顺畅沟通。

title: Business Development Intern (Open)
description:
部署紹介/Business Unit
全世界で12億人以上のユーザーを誇る WeChat は、中国と世界中の人々、サービス、企業をつなぎ、モバイルの未来を大きく変革しています。海外市場で WeChat Pay として知られる Weixin Pay は、2013年にWeixinによって導入されたモバイル決済ソリューションです。銀行口座と Weixin Pay アカウントを連携させることで、ユーザーは迅速かつ便利で、安全な決済や取引をスムーズに完了できます。
中国国内では、Weixin Pay は日常生活のあらゆる場面に溶け込み、オンラインまたはオフラインを問わず、小売、飲食、交通、ヘルスケア、レジャーといったさまざまな分野で、効率的かつスマートな決済サービスを提供しています。日本においては、WeChat Pay チームが日本市場全体でのサービス拡大に尽力しています。

With over 1.2 billion users worldwide, WeChat is changing the mobile landscape by connecting people, services, and businesses in China and around-the world. Weixin Pay, referred to as WeChat Pay in overseas markets, is a mobile payment solution jointly launched by Weixin in 2013. After bundling their Weixin Pay accounts with bank cards, Weixin Pay users can pay and complete transactions in a fast, convenient, and secure manner.
In China, Weixin Pay touches almost every aspect of everyday life, providing both online and offline services and giving users a highly efficient and intelligent payment experience, particularly in retail, dining, transportation, healthcare and leisure, and more. The WeChat Pay team in Japan is responsible for its increasing in all aspects of Japanese markets.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

- ビジネスオペレーション（Business Operations）：Business Development（BD）チームと連携し、顧客関係の強化およびビジネス機会の開拓を推進。

- Key Account（KA）加盟店・機関と連携し、導入、販促物、キャンペーン施策等の推進を行う。

- 市場調査（Market Research）：以下を含むが、これらに限定されない。A. 店舗巡回（Store Inspection）：オフライン店舗を訪問し、販促物の設置状況を確認。B. 市場動向調査（Market Dynamics）：オンライン調査、業界レポート、現地訪問を通じて重要な市場情報を定期的に収集し、決済エコシステムの健全性を評価・比較。C. ユーザー調査（User Research）：現地訪問やオンラインアンケートを通じて、ユーザー浸透率およびユーザー体験に関するデータを収集。

- 販促物展開（Material Deployment）：機関側ではカバーが難しいエリアやシーンに対して、現地での販促物設置を実施。

- 協業開拓（Collaboration Exploration）：大学サークルや主要商業エリア等との連携を推進し、ユーザーコミュニティ向けマーケティング浸透を実施。現地で消費行動を観察し、調査・データ分析を行いながら、WeChatエコシステム内での協業機会を探索。

- 高い主体性とセルフマネジメント能力を持ち、自律的かつ積極的に業務を推進・完遂できる

賃金
年収額：応相談（昇給/賞与あり）

完全週休２日制（土日・祝日）

健康保険 、雇用保険、 労災保険、 厚生年金保険、 総合福祉団体定期保険（GTL）
業務災害安心総合保険（GPA）、団体長期障害所得補償保険（GLTD）

About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails
We are seeking a driven and culturally savvy Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market efforts for our flagship global gaming titles, with a primary focus on the MENA region. In this role, you will craft and execute data-informed marketing strategies that reflect regional market dynamics, local user behavior, cultural calendars, and product release milestones — all in service of growing brand equity, user engagement, and positive community sentiment, while hitting regional publishing targets.
1. Regional Marketing & Campaign Execution

•
Lead user insight gathering, selling-point articulation, and creative marketing planning for key global titles.

•
Drive end-to-end campaign delivery aligned with version updates, local festivals, and brand marketing needs — managing timelines, asset preparation, resource coordination, and execution tracking to ensure on-time, on-brief completion.

•
Collaborate with internal creative, product, and business development teams to align global brand strategy with local market execution.

2. KOL, Creator & Community Ecosystem

•
KOL & Creator Sourcing: Identify, outreach, onboard, and maintain relationships with a diverse pool of regional KOLs, KOL vendors/agencies, and micro-creators across platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch).

•
Briefing & Quality Control: Develop clear, platform-native creative briefs for influencers and agencies; review content deliverables for brand alignment, quality, and compliance.

•
Incentive & Growth Programs: Iterate on localized creator incentive frameworks (tiered rewards, affiliate programs, early-access perks) to boost content volume, quality, and conversion efficiency.

•
Community Support & Management: Partner with community managers to nurture official and grassroots player communities across Discord, Reddit, WhatsApp, and regional social platforms. Ensure timely response loops, sentiment tracking, and escalation protocols are in place.

•
Vendor Management: Own relationships with KOL agencies and influencer marketing platforms — negotiate contracts, track performance KPIs (CPM, CPV, engagement rate, conversion), and optimize spend across campaigns.

3. Local Events & Cross-Industry Partnerships

•
Support regional event delivery (esports tournaments, fan meetups, launch parties, convention appearances) in coordination with global HQ and local partners.

•
Identify and execute brand/IP crossover opportunities, connecting internal and external resources to ensure efficient cross-team collaboration and deal closure.

4. Market Intelligence & Localization Insights

•
Maintain a continuous pulse on regional social media ecosystems (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat), emerging platform trends, player preferences, and competitor activity.

•
Translate cultural and platform insights into actionable, compliance-aware creative recommendations for the broader marketing team.

•
Proactively build understanding of MENA-specific cultural norms, religious sensitivities (e.g. Ramadan, Eid), content regulations, and platform policies.

5. Content Ecosystem & Scalable Production

•
Explore lightweight, scalable content production models — including UGC campaigns, AI-assisted content tools, and template-driven workflows — to lower creative barriers for players and micro-creators.

•
Repurpose and localize English-language assets for regional audiences; identify and amplify high-performing local KOC (Key Opinion Consumer) content to fuel regional growth.

Who We Look For

Education & Experience

•
Bachelor’s degree or above.

•
5+ years of experience in gaming marketing, global publishing, or related fields.

•
Experience with global publishing or emerging markets (especially MENA) is a strong plus.

Language

•
English: Professional working proficiency — must be able to lead meetings, write briefs, and collaborate cross-culturally in English.

•
Arabic: A significant advantage, but not required.

Gaming Literacy

•
Deep passion for the gaming industry. Must have hands-on experience with at least 3–6 major mobile, PC, or console titles.

•
In-depth experience with GTA-like or open-world action titles is highly preferred.

Core Competencies

•
Collaboration & Communication: Strong team player with excellent cross-functional and cross-cultural communication skills.

•
Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously; detail-oriented while maintaining a big-picture view.

•
Resilience & Drive: Self-starter with high accountability, strong execution capability, and the ability to thrive under pressure.

•
Market Acumen: Sharp market instincts, rapid learning agility, and a bias toward data-informed decision-making.

•
Cultural Compliance Awareness: Willingness and ability to learn regional cultural, religious, and regulatory nuances — particularly for the MENA region — and apply them to marketing practice.

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent

As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.

title: 预装渠道运营
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. 渠道拓展：开拓海外头部手机厂商（传音、小米、三星、OPPO/VIVO 等）的预装资源，包括装机必备文件夹、小游戏中心、系统桌面负一屏、出厂默认推荐位等核心坑位，并维护长期合作关系；
2. 商务模式：针对休闲游戏 LTV 较低的特点主导商务谈判，设计并跑通 CPA、CPD及广告收益分成等合作模型，控制单激活成本；
3. 技术落地：协同技术团队推进 Stub 、即玩、云游戏微端在厂商端的系统级应用，保障低配机型与弱网环境下用户也能秒级激活；
4. 归因管理：负责对接并精细化配置主流 MMP，主导制定 Stub 包激活、延迟激活等场景的归因规则；
5. 数据清洗与反作弊：建立数据清洗机制，通过首次联网时间、机型激活时差、行为特征等维度，剔除预装对自然量及线上买量渠道的归因污染与重复计费；建立反作弊监控模型，识别设备农场、GAID/IMEI 篡改、点击劫持等作弊流量；
6. 工具建设：协同 BI 打通厂商后台激活数据、MMP、自建日志与广告变现数据，输出预装渠道专属 ROI、LTV 曲线、回本周期的看板；

岗位要求

1. 5 年以上海外游戏发行/运营经验，其中至少 2 年聚焦休闲游戏（消除、解谜、合成、超休闲等）的 OEM 厂商预装、云预装或游戏联运运营；
2. 精通主流 MMP的预装归因底层逻辑，深刻理解各手机厂商预装激活的统计口径差异；
3. 数据能力扎实，能使用 SQL 独立完成千万级行为数据的筛选、去重与清洗；有 Python（Pandas/NumPy）数据处理或协同 BI 建模经验者加分；
4. 要求具备极强的项目推进能力，能适应多款游戏同时多渠道排期预装的快节奏，能接受定期海外出差；
5. 英语流利，可作为工作语言，能独立完成与海外厂商总部及区域分公司的商务谈判与日常对接。

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Product Manager, WorkBuddy Enterprise — Agent Platform
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
The Product Manager, WorkBuddy Enterprise — will own the enterprise roadmap and customer success strategy for the WorkBuddy Enterprise platform, including WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, and Managed Agents. This role drives the platform’s competitive positioning in the global enterprise AI market, covering the full lifecycle from architectural design to production-grade delivery for key enterprise customers.

• Define and own the enterprise product roadmap and go-to-market strategy for WorkBuddy Enterprise, driving platform competitiveness and customer adoption across international markets while aligning with business growth and commercial targets.

• Lead the ecosystem and integration strategy for enterprise Skills, MCP, and Connector frameworks, enabling seamless interoperability across third-party, customer-built, and ecosystem services to support enterprise agent and digital employee deployments.

• Establish reliability and evaluation (Eval) infrastructure, including eval harnesses, agent safety guardrails, trajectory replay, production telemetry, and automated regression testing, to elevate Proof of Concept success rates to production-grade standards.

• Partner with sales and solutions teams to build a structured key-account delivery system, distilling implementation experience from top enterprise customers into reusable templates and best practices that accelerate time-to-value.

Who We Look For

• At least six years of product management experience, including at least three years in AI platforms, cloud platforms, developer tools, or enterprise SaaS, with a proven track record of independently owning platform products (PaaS, SDK, API, or SaaS) for enterprise customers.

• Demonstrated commercial acumen with hands-on experience across the full product lifecycle, from product definition and design to go-to-market optimisation, including familiarity with ARR, gross margin, net revenue retention (NRR), and paid conversion metrics.

• Deep understanding and practical use of AI and large language model products from providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS, and Microsoft, together with knowledge of agent orchestration engineering and product design trade-offs.

• Strong enterprise platform knowledge, including SSO, SCIM, RBAC, data residency, tenant isolation, and audit logging, with familiarity with domestic and international security compliance frameworks and certification processes.

title: 3D Artist Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team
Level Infinite is Tencent’s global gaming brand. It is a global game publisher offering a comprehensive network of services for games, development teams, and studios around the world.

We are dedicated to delivering engaging and original gaming experiences to a worldwide audience, whenever and wherever they choose to play while building a community that fosters inclusivity, connection, and accessibility. Level Infinite also provides a wide range of services and resources to our network of developers and partner studios around the world to help them unlock the true potential of their games.

What the Role Entails

•
Responsible for creating high-quality hard-surface game assets, including vehicles, weapons, machinery, sci-fi environment props, and other related objects. Work includes high-poly modeling, low-poly modeling, and UV unwrapping/layout.

•
Responsible for baking normal maps and related texture maps from high-poly models to low-poly models, and creating realistic material and texture effects based on the PBR workflow.

•
Import completed assets into mainstream game engines such as Unreal Engine or Unity, and collaborate with programmers and game designers to restore and adjust the final in-engine visual results.

•
Work with the team to explore how generative AI tools, such as Midjourney and Hunyuan 3D, can be integrated into early- and mid-stage asset production workflows, including concept design support and texture generation assistance.

Who We Look For

• Majors in art, digital media, 3D animation, game design, or related fields are preferred. Outstanding candidates from other backgrounds are also welcome. A personal portfolio is required, including complete hard-surface and PBR works.

• Proficient in at least one mainstream 3D modeling software, such as Maya, 3ds Max, or Blender. Solid foundation in hard-surface modeling, with clean topology, reasonable edge flow, and accurate structural design.

• Proficient in Substance Painter or Mari for PBR material and texture creation, with a strong eye for material qualities such as metal, plastic, paint, wear, scratches, and surface aging.

• Familiar with the complete high-poly to low-poly baking workflow using tools such as Marmoset Toolbag or Substance Painter. Able to accurately preserve high-poly details while maintaining proper low-poly polygon counts and topology structure.

• Familiar with common AI image generation and model design workflows. Able to use AI tools to quickly extract design inspiration, assist in concept sketch generation, or support texture and material creation, such as using Stable Diffusion to enhance detail maps or understanding the basic principles of AI image-to-3D workflows.

• Strong self-learning ability and teamwork spirit. Passionate about emerging technologies, such as virtualized micropolygon geometry technology and AI-assisted production workflows.

Nice to Have

• Proficiency in Blender for efficient hard-surface modeling, including experience with plugins such as HardOps and Boxcutter.

• Hands-on experience integrating assets into Unreal Engine 5 or Unity projects/demos, with basic understanding of material node setup.

• Ability to use Stable Diffusion or Midjourney for controllable image generation, with practical experience integrating AI into production workflows, such as creating seamless textures or developing concept base designs.

• Familiarity with ZBrush sculpting, especially for assets involving both hard-surface and organic elements, or complex surface wear and damage details.

title: Brand Marketing Intern
description:
About the Hiring Team

What the Role Entails

ABOUT LEVEL INFINITE

Level Infinite is Tencent Games' global publishing label, bringing world-class gaming experiences to players across more than 200 countries and regions. We work across a diverse portfolio of games — from action RPGs to casual mobile titles — and are building the brand infrastructure to match our global ambitions. This isn't just a publishing house; it's a brand being built in real time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a driven, focused intern to join our Brand Marketing team at our Playa Vista office. You'll work together with senior brand and marketing professionals, getting hands-on exposure to how a global gaming brand is built — from influencer campaigns to community activations to live events.

This role sits at the intersection of brand, marketing, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll regularly interface with stakeholders across game teams, partnerships, PR, and regional offices — helping coordinate projects, align on priorities, and keep momentum going. It's a high-exposure position with a real learning curve: you'll see how decisions get made, how campaigns come together, and how a growing global brand operates day to day. If you're someone who thrives in

fast-moving environments, loves gaming culture, and wants to learn the craft of brand-building from the inside, this is your seat at the table.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support day-to-day coordination across influencer marketing, community, and events campaigns — tracking deliverables, timelines, and partner communications

• Assist in identifying, vetting, and onboarding content creators and influencers across YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, and Instagram

• Help manage community touchpoints including social listening, Discord/Reddit monitoring, and fan engagement initiatives

• Coordinate logistics for online and offline events — including game launches, tournaments, and brand activations

• Draft briefs, recaps, trackers, and decks to support campaign planning and reporting

• Act as a reliable communication bridge between internal stakeholders (Brand, Marketing, Game Teams) and external partners

• Research trends in gaming culture, creator ecosystems, and competitor brand activities to inform strategy

• Shadow senior brand team members across planning sessions, partner calls, and creative reviews

Who We Look For

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field

• Genuine passion for gaming — you follow the industry, know the games, and understand the culture

• Prior experience or coursework in at least one of: influencer/creator marketing, community management, or event coordination (internships, club work, and personal projects all count)

• Highly organized, with a natural instinct for follow-up and keeping projects on track

• Comfortable working across time zones with remote and distributed teams

• Familiarity with tools like Notion, Airtable, Google Workspace, AI Platforms or similar project management/collaboration software is a plus

• A proactive attitude — you ask questions, raise your hand, and bring ideas to the table

NICE TO HAVE

• Active presence in gaming communities (Discord, Reddit, Twitch, etc.) — as a player, mod, or creator

• Experience running or supporting brand social accounts

• Exposure to campaign analytics and reporting (engagement rates, reach, conversion tracking)

WHAT YOU'LL GET

• Real responsibility from day one — not a fetch-coffee internship

• Direct mentorship from experienced brand and marketing professionals

• Front-row access to how a major global gaming brand operates behind the scenes

• Meaningful exposure to cross-functional stakeholders — game teams, PR, partnerships, and regional offices — giving you a full picture of how a global publisher operates

• A portfolio-worthy experience with tangible campaigns and activations to point to

Location State(s)

US-California-Los Angeles, US-California-Palo Alto

The expected base pay range for this position in the location(s) listed above is $24.81 to $42.70 per hour. Actual pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
This position will be eligible for 1 hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked and up to 13 paid holidays throughout the calendar year. title: コンセプトアーティスト｜Concept Artist
description:
チーム紹介/About the Hiring Team
ライトスピード・ジャパンは、世界中のオーディエンス向けにオリジナルのAAA級アクションゲームタイトルの制作に特化しているゲーム開発スタジオです。著名なゲームディレクターとして知られる伊津野英昭（いつの ひであき）が率いる当スタジオは、東京と大阪の2つの拠点で活動しています。

柔軟で包括的な職場環境を提供し、ゲーム制作の限界を押し広げる才能と情熱にあふれるゲームクリエイターの参加を非常に歓迎しています。

LightSpeed Japan Studio is a game development studio dedicated to crafting original AAA action game titles for global audiences. Led by industry veteran Hideaki Itsuno, the studio operates across two locations in Tokyo and Osaka.

The studio offers a flexible and inclusive work environment and actively welcomes game creators who are full of talent and passion for pushing the boundaries of game development.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails

仕事内容

1.  フォトリアルなビジュアルコンセプトの作成

ゲームや映像作品の世界観、キャラクター、背景などのビジュアルコンセプトを作成し、作品全体のビジュアル方向性を視覚的に表現する。

2.  フォトリアルなキャラクターおよびエネミーデザイン

ゲーム内のキャラクターや敵キャラクターのデザインを担当し、キャラクターの性格や背景に基づいて個性的で魅力的なビジュアルを創り上げる。

3.  環境デザインと世界観の構築

ゲーム内のステージや環境、背景アートをデザインし、プレイヤーが没入できる世界観を提供する。

4.  ビジュアルスタイルガイドラインの策定

ゲーム全体のビジュアルスタイルを定め、キャラクター、エフェクト、背景などのアート要素が統一されるようにガイドラインを作成する。

5.  他部門との協力

ゲームデザイナーや3Dアーティストと連携し、ビジュアル要素がゲームプレイに適切に統合されるように調整する。

6.  外部協力会社への発注準備、指定書制作、アートの監修

Job Description

1. Creation of Photorealistic Visual Concepts
Develop visual concepts that express the overall visual direction of games or visual works, including the world, characters, and environments, with a photorealistic style.

2. Photorealistic Character and Enemy Design
Design in-game characters and enemies based on their personality and background, creating unique and visually compelling representations.

3. Environment Design and World-Building
Design in-game stages, environments, and background art to deliver an immersive world that enhances player engagement.

4. Development of Visual Style Guidelines
Establish visual style guidelines for the game to ensure consistency across all art elements, including characters, effects, and backgrounds.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with game designers and 3D artists to ensure visual elements are well-integrated into the gameplay experience.

6. Art Supervision and Documentation for External Partners
Prepare briefing materials and specifications for outsourcing, and supervise art production by external vendors to maintain quality and consistency.

応募資格/Who We Look For

応募条件

1.  コンセプトアート経験

ゲーム業界でのコンセプトアート経験（AAAタイトル経験者優遇）。キャラクター、環境、エフェクトのデザインに関する豊富な知識と実績。

2.  デザインツールの使用スキル

PhotoshopやIllustratorなどの主要なデザインツールを使いこなすスキル。

3.  3Dアートの基本的理解

3Dソフトウェア（Maya、ZBrushなど）の基本的な知識があり、3Dアートとの連携ができる能力。

4.  チームワークとコミュニケーション能力

他のアーティストやディレクターと円滑に連携し、プロジェクトを進めるための優れたコミュニケーションスキル。

5.  フィードバックへの柔軟な対応

チームメンバーやクライアントからのフィードバックを適切に受け入れ、柔軟に改善・修正できる能力。

Requirements

1. Concept Art Experience
Experience in concept art within the gaming industry (experience with AAA titles is a plus). Strong knowledge and a proven track record in designing characters, environments, and effects.

2. Proficiency with Design Tools
Advanced skills in using major design tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator.

3. Basic Understanding of 3D Art
Fundamental knowledge of 3D software (e.g., Maya, ZBrush) and the ability to collaborate effectively with 3D artists.

4. Teamwork and Communication Skills
Excellent communication skills to work smoothly with other artists and directors, contributing to overall project success.

5. Flexibility in Responding to Feedback
Ability to accept and incorporate feedback from team members and clients with a flexible and constructive attitude.

一緒に働く魅力/Why Join Us?

title: Tencent Cloud Senior Industry Product Operations Manager — Risk Control & Anti-Fraud (Malaysia)
description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
We are looking for a (Senior) Industry Product Operations Manager with solid experience in risk control, anti-fraud, business security, and financial risk management, as well as strong commercialisation capabilities and bilingual communication skills in native language and English.
This role will be responsible for supporting the commercialisation and solution delivery of Tencent Cloud Risk Control Solution, TCRS, in overseas markets. The position will serve as a critical bridge between product, sales, solution, delivery, and client teams.

The successful candidate will be expected to deeply understand overseas clients’ risk challenges across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing campaigns, transactions, payments, credit application, account security, and user lifecycle management. The candidate will translate Tencent Cloud’s capabilities in business security, risk identification, anti-fraud, device risk, account security, payment risk control, and financial risk management into industry solutions that are sellable, deliverable, and scalable.
This role requires not only strong technical understanding, but also strong business acumen, client communication skills, and solution packaging capabilities. The candidate will support overseas sales teams throughout the full sales cycle, including requirement discovery, solution design, client presentation, product demonstration, POC execution, pricing support, and commercial conversion.
1. Drive Overseas Commercialisation of TCRS

• Lead the solution design and commercial landing of Tencent Cloud TCRS products in overseas markets, covering risk control, anti-fraud, and financial risk management.

• Develop industry-specific solutions for clients in fintech, digital banking, consumer finance, payments, e-commerce, gaming, content platforms, and social networking.

• Translate TCRS capabilities, including device risk, account security, transaction risk control, payment risk control, credit risk control, rule engines, and model scoring, into clear business value that clients can understand.

2. Support the End-to-End Overseas Sales Process

• Support sales, business development, and channel teams in client requirement discovery, solution design, technical engagement, product demonstration, POC execution, and pricing support.

• Independently conduct product introductions, solution walkthroughs, technical Q&A, and value presentations to clients in both native language and English.

• Help identify clients’ real pain points, purchasing motivations, and decision-making processes, and drive opportunities from the requirement stage to POC, quotation, and contract signing.

3. Design Anti-Fraud and Business Security Solutions

• Analyse client risk issues and design solutions across scenarios such as registration, login, marketing, transactions, payments, and account security.

• Cover typical risk cases including fake registration, account theft, marketing abuse, promotion abuse, card-not-present fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, and organised fraud.

• Design localised risk control solutions by combining capabilities such as device risk, behavioural risk, IP risk, account risk, relationship networks, rules, and machine learning models.

4. Support Financial Risk Management Solutions

• Design pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan risk management solutions for financial clients, including digital banks, consumer finance companies, cash loan providers, BNPL platforms, payment institutions, and e-wallets.

• Cover key scenarios such as identity verification, application fraud detection, credit assessment, credit approval, limit management, transaction monitoring, post-loan early warning, and collection segmentation.

• Support financial clients in POC test design, performance evaluation, strategy optimisation, and business value assessment.

5. Drive Product Requirement Closure

• Collect overseas client requirements related to anti-fraud, payment risk control, credit risk management, and compliance risk management, and translate them into product requirements and implementation roadmaps.

• Work closely with product, R&D, algorithm, data, delivery, and sales teams to convert client requirements into product capabilities.

• Consolidate project experience from key accounts and develop standardised industry solutions, case studies, POC templates, and sales enablement tools.

6. Sales Enablement and Market Insights

• Deliver product training, industry training, case study training, and competitor training to sales, business development, channel, and partner teams.

• Produce materials such as product introductions, industry solution decks, client case studies, FAQs, competitor analysis, and deployment documentation.

• Track overseas trends in risk control, anti-fraud, fintech, and compliance, and provide input to support the overseas GTM strategy of TCRS.

Who We Look For

• Bachelor’s degree or above;

• Minimum 5 years of experience in internet risk control, anti-fraud, business security, fintech risk management, payment risk control, credit risk management, or related fields.

• Excellent bilingual communication skills in native language and English, with the ability to conduct client communication, solution presentations, business discussions, document drafting, and cross-border team collaboration in English. Madarin Speaking skill is a Plus.

• Strong client-facing communication skills and business understanding, with the ability to independently conduct requirement discovery, solution articulation, and value presentation.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration capabilities, with the ability to coordinate product, R&D, algorithm, delivery, sales, and partner resources to drive complex projects to successful delivery.

title: PC/Console 项目数据分析师（Publishing Data Analyst）
description:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。

Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责

1. 产品预估模型

• 构建并迭代发行预估模型：基于品类基准、愿望单、Beta 测试、UR 测试，输出保守/基准/乐观三档销量与收入预估

• 校准 Steam 愿望单→首周转化率、首月→首年系数等关键参数，建立内部 Benchmark 数据库

• 按平台（Steam/Xbox/PS/Epic）拆分预测，结合分成阶梯、区域定价、退款率建模

2. 竞品与品类分析

• 维护 PC/Console 核心品类竞品数据库：销量估算、DAU/MAU、定价、更新频率、评测情感

• 定期输出品类趋势报告：新品成功率、头部集中度、品类增长/衰退信号

3. P&L 建模与敏感度分析

• 构建多年度 P&L 模型（收入侧：本体/GaaS/DLC；成本侧：研发/营销/平台/运营）

• 计算 Break-Even 销量、回本周期、LTV/CAC 等投资决策指标

4. 玩家行为与运营分析

• 设计核心指标体系：获客（Wishlist/CTR）、活跃（DAU/MAU）、留存（D1/D7/D30）、付费（ARPU/转化率/LTV）

• Beta 测试数据分析：玩家进度、付费意愿信号，输出优化建议

• 上线后 Live Ops 数据支持：赛季效果分析、版本更新 lift 测算

5. 数据基建

• 推动竞品/平台/游戏内数据的自动化采集与 ETL 管线

• 搭建发行侧 BI 看板（Tableau/Power BI/Metabase），为团队提供自助查询能力

岗位要求

1、PC/主机经验，5 年以上数据分析经验，其中至少 2 年游戏行业数据分析（PC/Console 优先）；或 5 年以上数据分析经验 + 自身为 PC/Console 重度核心玩家（Steam/PSN/Xbox 游戏库 100+），深度理解玩家行为与游戏生态

2、英语作为工作语言，能流畅阅读英文行业报告（Newzoo/SteamDB/GameDiscoverCo），分析 Steam 英文评测文本情感，参与英文会议讨论；

3、数据分析/商业分析/数据科学岗位累计 5 年以上，有预测建模或预估模型的实际构建经验；

4、熟练掌握 SQL，能独立完成复杂查询与数据清洗

5、熟练使用 Python 或 R 进行数据建模与统计分析

6、熟练使用至少一种 BI 工具（Tableau / Power BI / Metabase / Looker Studio）

7、数据叙事能力：将分析结果转化为清晰的结构化报告与可视化呈现

8、了解 PC/Console 游戏生态：愿望单、商店页、评测机制、赛季运营

加分项

• Steam 数据源实操（SteamDB / GameSensor / VG Insights / GameDiscoverCo）

• Game Analytics / Firebase / PlayFab 等游戏分析工具使用经验

• 爬虫开发经验（Scrapy / API 接入）

• 游戏经济系统分析能力

• A/B 测试设计与分析经验

腾讯致力于提供平等就业机会

在腾讯，我们始终秉承平等就业机会的原则，致力于为每一位员工打造公平、包容的工作环境。我们坚信，多元的声音能够激发出无限的创新活力，推动我们为用户和社会提供更优质的服务。我们用心营造一个充满支持与激励的氛围，帮助每一位员工找到属于自己的舞台，以实现个人及共同的发展目标。

title: Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern
description:
Business Unit
At Tencent Finance, we are deeply committed to fostering the professional growth of our staff through tailored finance training, mentorship programs, job rotation initiatives, and support for finance professional certifications. Recognized as an approved employer by esteemed organizations like ACCA, HKICPA, CIMA, CPA Australia, and CA, and certified accredited trainer with the Singapore Accountancy Commission, we provide comprehensive resources and guidance to ensure our employees remain at the forefront of the rapidly evolving finance landscape. Whether you're a recent graduate or an experienced hire, we empower you to acquire and maintain professional qualifications, enhancing your credibility and competence in the finance domain while keeping you competitive in the ever-changing industry.

What the Role Entails

Join our dynamic Tencent Finance team as Financial Accounting and Analysis Intern where you'll have the opportunity to immerse yourself in real-world accounting and financial practices. You will be having the exposure to the end-to-end accounting and finance processes, focusing either on General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Finance Operations, offering you tailored hands-on experience in the complex commercial and business environment. This role is designed to provide you with a deep understanding of financial processes, contributing directly to the accuracy and efficiency of our financial reporting and operations.

Responsibilities

• Maintain and reconcile the General Ledger (GL), ensuring accurate and timely financial entries.

• Assist in month-end and year-end closing activities, including account reconciliations, financial statement preparation, and variance analysis.

• Verify, process, and manage Accounts Payable (AP) transactions, ensuring timely vendor payments and handling any discrepancies.

• Support Accounts Receivable (AR) activities by assisting in customer invoicing, tracking payments, and managing overdue receivables.

• Collaborate with teams to streamline Finance Operations, helping to enhance process efficiency and support financial audits by preparing relevant documentation.

• Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards, contributing to continuous improvements across finance functions.

Who We Look For

•
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy or a related discipline.

•
Able to commit to a full-time internship for 4-6 months.

•
Demonstrated ability to apply accounting knowledge in practical scenarios, particularly in identifying and resolving issues.

•
Strong analytical and presentation skills.

•
Excellent written and spoken English required. Working proficiency in Mandarin required, as approximately 80% of the role involves coordinating with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and regional teams.
